I am writing to refer this patient under the lower GI suspected cancer pathway. She first presented six weeks ago describing rectal bleeding on wiping, which has since progressed to blood mixed with stool on most days. Alongside this she has noticed a change in bowel habit, with stools becoming looser and more frequent.

She has also experienced unintentional weight loss of around five kilograms over the past three months without dietary change. Her FIT test returned a positive FIT result at 185 micrograms of haemoglobin per gram.

She has a family history of bowel cancer in a first-degree relative.
